positions.name: AtlasRollbackCadence
positions.frame: does this set establish a settled operational cadence for Atlas rollback rehearsals, backed by a constitutive rationale and named ownership?
positions.why: src-1 issues the monthly-cadence directive, src-3 restates it as a formal metadata artifact, and src-4 assigns ownership — all three perform the same settled, decision-grade institution of the rehearsal schedule. src-2 supplies the aphoristic rationale ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have') that makes the cadence self-evidently necessary rather than argued case-by-case. Read together, the four expressions cohere as one act: mandate plus justification plus accountability for a single recurring practice.
